verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a public service with an online documentation surface, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows an llms.txt file or any agent-oriented documentation. The evidence covers only human-facing gov.uk guidance pages and a robots.txt probe on the search host, which shows that host turns away keyless agents rather than offering agent-targeted docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
